europe_now.title: France Restricts Public Spaces and Deploys Heavy Security Amid Nationwide Unrest
europe_now.summary: French authorities deployed heavy police forces and closed major Paris museums as hundreds of protests and heightened security measures swept across the country following recent riots. The demonstrations reflect ongoing public tensions and societal division following significant unrest and a recent terrorist attack investigated near Paris.

europe_now.title: Bulgarian Presidential Election Poses Test for Incumbent Leadership
europe_now.summary: Bulgaria's upcoming presidential election has emerged as a significant political test regarding President Rumen Radev's grip on power. Observers are closely following the electoral developments as a key indicator of the country's political direction and institutional stability.

sources.headline: [Interview] Bulgaria’s presidential election becomes a test of Rumen Radev’s grip on power

top_stories.title: French Civil Unrest and Security Measures
top_stories.summary: Law enforcement agencies across France have deployed massive security personnel in response to ongoing public demonstrations and heightened civil tensions. Major cultural sites in Paris have been closed as the nation grapples with widespread protests and security challenges.

top_stories.title: Bulgarian Electoral Politics
top_stories.summary: Bulgaria is preparing for a presidential election that will determine the political future and influence of incumbent leader Rumen Radev. The electoral contest serves as a critical measure of shifting political alignments within the nation.
